title: Prove admission journeys on the delivered candidate
text: Source tests and UI fixtures cover personal approval, teammate redemption, Team and token recovery; they do not prove deployment. Still owed: the changed hosted Team consumer against the exact engine candidate, production delivery evidence, published-wheel installation and production Browser proof of Machines, Team and Profile at desktop and narrow widths in both themes. Keep failures and reruns tied to the candidate. The eight own-machine, teammate-invite, company-sign-in and local-refusal cases in human and agent presentations were transferred to YOK-4209 and are not implemented or passed here. That work also owns the missing real disposable candidate server and human-only gate; the existing self-approving browser fixture cannot prove a person's authority. Keep the original 25 campaign cases unchanged and retain the private agent-to-TUI invite handoff. Hosted mirror removal still waits for consumer and zero-pending evidence; historical secret cleanup and its every-universe proof remain separate outstanding work.
